notes: Desktop standalone DJ controller/media player (built-in speakers, 7" touchscreen); not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Also has a 1x SD card slot for storage — omitted from ports list because no connector id in the allowed taxonomy corresponds to a memory-card slot. No grade set on any port: USB ports have no stated version/speed in manufacturer specs, and none of the other connectors (XLR, RCA, TRS/TS, DC barrel) are bandwidth-graded connector types per the taxonomy rules. Mic input connector shown as ts-6.35 (unbalanced 1/4"); manufacturer copy just says "1/4" microphone input" without explicitly confirming TS vs TRS, so this is a light inference. Cross-checked against B&H/VirtualDJ manual excerpts and Numark's own product page; all three agree on port counts and types. This is the original "Mixstream Pro" (not the later "Mixstream Pro+" or "Mixstream Pro Go" variants, which differ in power spec — Pro Go uses 19V/3.42A).
